name: application-mobile-filter-sheet
title: Mobile Filter Sheet
description: A full-screen mobile filter form with price range, category checkboxes, size chips, an availability toggle, and a sticky apply footer.
useWhen: A mobile app or responsive site needs a dedicated, full-screen filtering experience reached from a 'Filters' button, rather than an always-visible panel.
The result count should update live in a sticky footer button ("Show 42 results") to preview the effect of filter changes before committing.
avoidWhen: Building a desktop or wide-viewport filtering UI — `Faceted Search Sidebar`'s persistent side panel fits that shape better.
Filters are simple enough for a single dropdown or a few inline chips — a dedicated full-screen sheet adds unnecessary navigation.
responsiveBehavior: Filter groups scroll independently in the middle section while the header (Cancel/Filters/Reset) and footer apply button stay pinned via shrink-0 flex children.
accessibility: Category options use real <label>/<input type="checkbox"> pairs, keyboard-reachable and screen-reader announced with their result counts.
Size chips use aria-pressed to expose selection state to assistive technology beyond the filled background color.
The availability switch is a labelled row so its on/off state is associated with visible text, not just the toggle's position.

variants.title: Shoe filters
variants.description: A full-screen filter sheet in a phone frame with a dual-handle price range slider, checkable category rows with counts, multi-select size chips, an in-stock-only toggle, and a sticky 'Show 42 results' footer button.
accessibility: Checkboxes and size chips expose their state via native inputs and aria-pressed, not color alone.

variants.title: Shoe filters (Dark)
variants.description: Mobile filter sheet adapted for dark surfaces, including the price slider track, selected size chips, and the toggle switch.
accessibility: All labels, counts, and the footer button text meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark sheet background.
